# Configuration Files Directory

This directory contains automatically generated proxy configurations.

## Files Generated

- `subscription.txt` - Base64 encoded subscription link
- `configs.json` - Complete configuration data
- `config_links.txt` - All working configuration links
- `vless_configs.txt` - VLESS protocol configurations
- `vmess_configs.txt` - VMess protocol configurations
- `trojan_configs.txt` - Trojan protocol configurations
- `statistics.txt` - Performance statistics
- `qr_codes/` - QR codes for mobile device setup

## Auto-Generated

These files are automatically generated by the GitHub Actions workflow.
